Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem and Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Are you organized, detail-oriented, and passionate about logistics? Join our team at SAESB as a Logistics Administrator and play a vital role in ensuring the seamless flow of goods across our operations.

Your role:
Are you detail-oriented, well-organized, and interested in logistics processes? We are looking for a Logistics Administrator to manage the entire administrative process for shipping and receiving goods. You will ensure timely deliveries while monitoring compliance with customs regulations.

Your responsibilities:
Administrative support for goods movement:

• Prepare shipping and receiving documents (such as Air Waybills and pro forma invoices).
• Create and follow up on purchase requisitions and orders in the ERP system.
• Ensure accurate and up-to-date data in IT systems.
Transport coordination:

• Schedule and monitor all transport bookings, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
Customs compliance:

• Verify and ensure adherence to applicable customs laws and regulations.
• Review documents for inbound and outbound shipments.
Reporting:

• Prepare and submit periodic reports on imports and exports.

Your Impact:

• Serve as the first point of contact for daily transport-related queries.
• Ensure timely and complete administrative handling of shipments and related reporting.
• Maintain proper documentation for customs and compliance purposes.

Your profile:

• A higher education degree.
• Solid proficiency in MS Office and ERP systems.
• Practical knowledge of ADR regulations, customs laws, and Incoterms (or willingness to follow training).
• Understanding of logistics operations, including both road and air freight.
• A structured and precise approach, consistently following established procedures.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset, able to anticipate and prevent issues.
• Flexibility to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
• Able to work independently after a six-month training period.
• Proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, sufficient for both internal communication and contacts with external suppliers.

The Logistic Warehouse Officer is responsible for the physical flow, the IT flow and the traceability of parts and modules in the preparation area before assembly and in the warehouse. He works in a production environment and reports to the Completion Manager, who in turn reports to the Supply Chain Director.

Your role:

• You provide logistical support for production, where needed, and anticipate the needs for the realization of the 'Shop Visit' of modules and engines.
• You manage the incoming flow of engine parts in production by ensuring their traceability.
• You ensure the management of priorities vis-à-vis the modules to be prepared and released.
• You guarantee the cleanliness and correct packaging of the parts in the store.
• You follow the work and safety instructions specific to the workstation and the company.
• You respect the internal quality regulations and the rules of logistics and administrative management of the company.
• You stimulate the sharing of knowledge in the group.
• You take initiatives and make proposals in the context of continuous improvement, pro-actively evaluate, coordinate the improvement of current work methods and new technologies as they arise.You maintain constructive and effective relations with production, configurators and other colleagues.

Your profile:

• You hold a higher secondary or technical education degree or have equivalent experience, with a basic understanding of logistics. A degree in logistics or a related field is a strong advantage.
• You are proficient in IT tools (Word, Excel, ERP) and hold a valid license for lifting equipment.
• You strive to become fully operational and autonomous within six months, following a period of training and learning.
• You possess strong communication skills, practical thinking, and initiative, while actively contributing to continuous improvement efforts.
• You are a team player with an open and adaptable mindset.
• You work in a two-shift system: one week from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m., followed by a week from 2 p.m. to 10 p.m.
• You are fluent in either French or Dutch, have at least a basic understanding of the second national language, and with a good level of English.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.description:
• Location: Antwerp, Belgium (Hybrid)

• Contract: 12-Month Initial Contract (Extension Likely)

Our client, a leading European Life Sciences & Healthcare organisation, is embarking on a large-scale IT, Cloud & Business Transformation Programme aimed at modernising core business applications, streamlining operational processes, and accelerating their cloud journey.

As the programme enters a critical delivery phase, they are looking for a highly hands-on Senior Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams, driving requirements definition, process optimisation, and transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams.

This is not a documentation-only role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being Embedded within the business, challenging existing ways of working, facilitating workshops, and actively shaping future-state solutions.
Responsibilities

• Engage with business and technical stakeholders to understand current-state processes and system landscapes.

• Lead requirements gathering workshops across multiple departments.

• Analyse and document complex business processes, identifying inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.

• Develop current-state and future-state process MAPS.

• Define and document business, functional and non-functional requirements.

• Translate business requirements into actionable functional specifications.

• Work closely with solution architects, developers, project managers and integration teams throughout project delivery.

• Support cloud migration and application transformation initiatives.

• Conduct gap analyses between legacy systems and future-state solutions.

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment and decision-making workshops.

• Support testing activities including UAT planning, execution and defect management.

• Track requirements through implementation to ensure business objectives are achieved.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across business and technology functions.

• 7+ years' experience as a Business Analyst within complex enterprise environments.

• Proven experience working on large-scale IT transformation programmes.

• Strong background in business process analysis and optimisation.

• Experience gathering and managing requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Demonstrated experience working on cloud transformation, digital transformation, ERP, CRM or systems integration projects.

• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and influence decisions.

• Strong workshop facilitation skills.

• Experience operating in Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

• Excellent communication skills with both business and technical audiences.

Preferred experience:

• Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Healthcare or Medical Devices industries.

• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

• Experience supporting application migration or modernisation programmes.

• Understanding of regulated environments and compliance requirements.

• Knowledge of data migration, integration projects or enterprise application landscapes.

Key skills:

• Business Analysis

• Requirements Engineering

• Process Mapping

• BPMN

• Stakeholder Management

• Workshop Facilitation

• Gap Analysis

• Systems Integration

• Cloud Transformation

• Agile Methodologies

• User Stories

• Functional Specifications

• UAT Management

• Change Management

Boury is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant with international recognition for its precision, refinement, and uncompromising quality standards. • Due to the international nature of our team, you are able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus.
